description: Employee with wages above the Social Security wage base: the excess pays Medicare tax only.
worked:
One employee, one employer, wages 250,000 in 2025.
Social Security (OASDI) employee tax: 2025 wage base 176,100; wages subject = smaller of 250,000 and 176,100 = 176,100 (73,900 above the base is not taxed); 6.2% x 176,100 = 10,918.20.
Medicare (hospital insurance) employee tax: no wage base; 1.45% x 250,000 = 3,625 (the 0.9% additional Medicare tax is figured on Form 8959 with the return, not here).
